https://www.ferngateriverside.com/guest-reviews

Rating: 2/5 stars
Review by: Desmond Achebe

I recently reserved the Alder Meeting Suite at the Ferngate Riverside Center to conduct a safety session for several recently transferred technicians on my team. – [1] –. The setting was superb, and the center’s café supplied excellent refreshments. – [2] –.

However, there were several equipment issues. The most serious problem was that the adapter we required to link the tablet to the display screen was missing. Although the front desk staff delivered it once we asked, it seemed unprofessional to not have the necessary hardware in the suite before our meeting began. – [3] –. And soon after our opening presentation started, the display screen began dimming. This was so disruptive that we had to call for assistance a second time. It took more than 15 minutes for the malfunction to be resolved. – [4] –.
